segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Oh hello ... I'd like to ask about insurance for my car.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Yes, of course. I'll just take a few details. What's your name?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: 27 Bank Road. Is that in Greendale?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: And what's your daytime phone number?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: And could I ask what your occupation is?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: OK ... now a few details about your car .. . What size is the engine?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Thank you .. . and the make and model?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Could you spell the model name please?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Ah yes .. . thanks. And when was it made?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Lovely .. . right . . . I presume you've had a previous insurer?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Right ... we need to know the name of the company.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Thank you, and have you made any insurance claims in the last five years?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: That's fine, Mr Jones .. . that's all we need to know at the moment .. .

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: And will there be any other named drivers?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Could you spell the surname please?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: OK !hank you .. . And what relationship is he to you?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: And what will you or Mr Paynter be using the car for?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Social use (murmuring). Will you be using it to travel to work?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: And finally ... when would you like to start the insurance?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: I'll need it from the 31st of January.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Right ... Mr Jones ... I'm getting a couple of quotes coming up on the computer now ... and the best bet looks like being with a company called Red Flag.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: And that comes out at $450 per year . . .

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Well .. . that seems OK ... it's quite a bit lower than I've been paying up to now ...

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Great .. . so would you like me to go ahead with that?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: How would you like to pay?
